name: GECLM completeness: stored comments vs submission num_comments
threshold: every subreddit-year with >= 100 threads (num_comments >= 10): median stored/claimed in [0.90, 1.15] and <= 5% of threads with ratio < 0.5
notes: num_comments is the submission snapshot at its retrieval time; stored comments include deleted/removed ones and any posted after that snapshot, so ratios slightly above 1 are expected.
